key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:16A0
name: configure_audio_channel_two
description: Programs the third audio channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register, then sets a global value to four, then one, then zero, and clears one memory location.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:16C4
name: configure_audio_channel_three
description: Programs the fourth audio channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register, then sets a global value to eight, then one, then zero, and clears one memory location.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:16E8
name: disable_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes the first audio channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register, then sets a global value to one and then to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:1702
name: disable_audio_channel_one
description: Writes the second audio channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register, then sets a global value to two and then to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:171C
name: disable_audio_channel_two
description: Writes the third audio channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register, then sets a global value to four and then to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:1736
name: disable_audio_channel_three
description: Writes the fourth audio channel's period and volume registers and the DMA control register, then sets a global value to eight and then to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:1750
name: read_next_sequence_entry
description: Reads the next byte-coded entry from a sequence in a channel structure and copies its fields into the structure and an output word, returning early on a zero entry. It also decrements a remaining count and subtracts a stored value from the entry when a configured value is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:1762
name: read_sequence_entry_from_pointer
description: Takes the next pointer from a list stored in a channel structure, reads the entry it points to, and copies its fields into the structure and an output word. It steps back one byte when the entry is a marker value, and returns early on a zero entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:26314
name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: Clears a flag byte at a fixed offset from the base register, calls another routine, then sets a global flag byte to one and returns the value that call produced.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:2632E
name: call_routine_then_set_flag
description: Calls another routine, then sets a global flag byte to one and passes back the two registers the call left behind.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:26346
name: find_first_set_slot
description: Clears a status bit in a flag byte and resets two state values when the input word is negative or a second flag is set. When a stored index is negative, it scans a table of up to eight bytes for the first non-zero entry, records that index and calls a routine with it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:263CE
name: set_flag_from_zero_test
description: Stores 255 into a byte at a fixed offset when a flag byte at another offset is zero, and stores 0 otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:263D2
name: store_zero_condition_byte
description: Stores 255 into a byte at a fixed offset when the zero condition left by the previous comparison holds, and stores 0 otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:263D8
name: reset_index_and_call_routine
description: Sets a word state value to minus one and clears a flag byte, sets a global value to zero and another global to nine, then calls a routine and returns its register results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:26402
name: dispatch_value_when_enabled
description: When an enable flag byte is set, it returns early for the value twenty unless a second flag is also set. Otherwise it clears a global flag, stores the incoming value into a global and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:26432
name: store_value_and_call_routine
description: Stores the incoming 32-bit value into a global variable and then calls another routine. It is reached from two unnamed routines and from a pointer table in the data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:26448
name: clamp_count_and_dispatch
description: When an enable flag is set, it limits the incoming count to sixty-three and, if any count remains, clears a global flag, stores the incoming value into a global and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:26476
name: call_routine_if_index_negative
description: Calls another routine only when an enable flag byte is set and a stored index word is negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:2649E
name: conditional_handler_dispatch
description: Passes the incoming value to another routine only when an enable flag is set, a small byte argument is below fifteen and a stored pointer is non-null. It clears a global flag and stores the value into a global before the call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:264E6
name: set_flag_byte_all_ones
description: Stores the value with all bits set into a byte at a fixed offset from the base register and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:3:264EE
name: reset_index_or_scan_slots
description: If a flag byte is clear, it resets an index word to minus one, clears a flag byte, sets a global to zero and another global to nine, then calls a routine. Otherwise it resets the index, clears a status bit, and scans a table of up to eight bytes for the first non-zero entry, records that index and calls a routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:7:4DEE
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the low byte of its input register unchanged, with no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:7:5C64
name: pass_through_byte_value
description: Returns the low byte of its input register unchanged. The pseudo-code shows no other work, so the routine only passes the value through.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:7:5C94
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing; the stub is reached through a single unnamed caller.

name: pass_through_byte_value
description: Returns the low byte of its input register unchanged. The pseudo-code shows no other work, so the routine only passes the value through.

name: pass_through_byte_value
description: Returns the low byte of its input register unchanged. The pseudo-code shows no other work, so the routine only passes the value through.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:8:43CA
name: pass_through_byte_value
description: Returns the low byte of its input register unchanged. The pseudo-code shows no other work, so the routine only passes the value through.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:3BAC
name: call_sequence_through_jump_table
description: Calls six routines through pointer slots held in a base-register table, with one direct call in the middle. The routine is reached through a pointer table in the data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:3C40
name: iterate_and_call_table_entries
description: Loops over a count stored in a structure. For each entry it calls one routine with an index, a value that starts at thirty and rises by ten (adding sixty-two to the first value when it passes 157), and a pointer that advances by twenty-eight bytes, then calls a second routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:534A
name: run_counted_call_sequences
description: Returns at once unless the low byte of its input is three. In that case it calls a routine, copies a stored word, then runs up to four counted loops that each call a routine a number of times read from a dispatch slot, capping one count at twenty-five.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5848
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing; the stub is reached through a single unnamed caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:584A
name: run_counted_call_sequences_alt
description: Returns at once unless the low byte of its input is three. Otherwise it calls a routine, then runs counted loops that call another routine a number of times read from a dispatch slot, capping one count at twenty-five.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5900
name: store_scaled_value_in_record
description: Sets two byte fields in a record to fixed values and copies one byte from a second record. It then computes a 64-bit value from a routine result scaled by four plus a stored value, writes it into two words of the record, and calls another routine through the table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5956
name: forward_call_through_table_slot
description: Calls one routine through a pointer slot in the base-register table and returns, forwarding the call with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:595C
name: copy_record_fields_and_accumulate
description: When a flag bit in a record is clear it copies one byte and sets another byte to 255. Otherwise it copies a block of words and bytes from one record into another, then calls routines through the table and adds their results into accumulator words in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5998
name: accumulate_value_into_record
description: Sets two byte fields in a record to fixed values, copies one byte from a second record, and adds a routine result scaled by four into accumulator words of the record. It finishes by calling further routines through the table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5A22
name: forward_call_through_table_slot
description: Calls one routine through a pointer slot in the base-register table and returns, forwarding the call with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5A28
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing; the stub is reached through a single unnamed caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5A2A
name: dispatch_by_count_value
description: Reads a byte from a record and calls a routine that returns a count. A count of two or more is returned minus one. A count of zero stores the saved byte into a field and sets another field to twenty before calling further routines; a count of one does the same and also adds one hundred thousand, then two hundred thousand, to a long field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5A40
name: store_byte_then_set_field
description: Calls a routine and, if it reports no failure, stores a byte from the data register into a record field, calls another routine, sets a second record field to twenty, and calls a final routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5A68
name: store_byte_and_add_amounts
description: Calls a routine and, if it reports no failure, stores a byte from the data register into a record field, sets another field to twenty, then adds one hundred thousand and two hundred thousand to a long field in the record across further routine calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5AC8
name: fetch_table_word_into_record
description: Calls a routine to get a value, uses its masked bits plus an offset to index a global table, and stores the word read there as a long field in the record. It also stores a constant byte of 251 into a second field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5B0E
name: conditionally_set_record_fields
description: When the zero condition from the prior test is clear, it calls a routine and returns early if that call reports a failure. Otherwise it sets one record field to 255, calls another routine, sets a second field to 44, and copies a byte from another record into a third field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5B52
name: decode_run_into_record
description: Reads several values through the call table and a lookup table to derive a count and flag bits for a record. A loop then fills a run of record bytes backwards from a computed position, and the flags and remaining count are written back before returning minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5B56
name: decode_run_after_notify
description: Calls a routine through the object's slot first, then does the same work as its neighbours: reads values through the call table and a lookup table, fills a run of record bytes backwards, and writes the flags and remaining count back, returning minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5C20
name: fill_run_from_partial_decode
description: Takes a byte index from a parameter and a remaining count, computes a clamped value from a lookup table, and fills a run of record bytes backwards with derived words written back into the record. Returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5CA4
name: fill_run_and_write_fields
description: Fills a run of record bytes backwards from a computed position with a value read through the call table, updates the remaining count and flag bits, then writes them into the record and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5D94
name: lookup_table_entry
description: Calls a routine for a value, combines it with a record byte and a parameter into a threshold, then scans a 16-bit table upward until an entry reaches that threshold. It returns the matching byte from a parallel byte table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5DC0
name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls one routine four times in succession and then returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5DD4
name: conditional_state_update
description: Calls a routine and stores its result in a record field, then calls a second routine. If that result is above three, it makes a further call and stores a word and a long value in the record when a returned value is non-negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5E2A
name: check_flag_and_call
description: Returns minus one after calling two routines when a short field in a global structure is non-zero, and returns zero otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5E50
name: scan_bit_flag_loop
description: When a short field is non-zero it steps through fixed-size records testing a flag bit in each, and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5E72
name: store_result_and_call
description: Calls a routine and stores its 32-bit result in a record field, then calls a method through an object pointer and returns the registers as they were.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:9:5E94
name: clear_structure_fields
description: Calls two routines through the base-register table, then clears a 32-bit field and a 16-bit field of the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:11:3820
name: clear_long_and_pass_byte
description: Clears a 32-bit value at a fixed offset from the base register and returns the low byte of its input unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:11:3854
name: clear_long_field_value
description: Clears a 32-bit value at a fixed offset from the base register and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:fltintro:0:0000
name: load_executable_hunks
description: Reads the hunk records of an Amiga executable and allocates memory for each hunk through the system library, copying its data in. It applies relocation records that add the load base to listed longwords, then calls routines to finish, stopping at the end-of-hunks marker.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:fltintro:0:017C
name: delay_countdown_loop
description: Loops, decrementing the low word of an input register until it passes zero, which gives a fixed-length timing delay. It returns with that register set to minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:fltintro:0:01CA
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing; the stub is reached through a single unnamed caller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:fltintro:0:01CC
name: unpack_packed_data_backwards
description: Decompresses a packed stream: it reads control values through a bit-reading routine, copies earlier runs of output backwards, and repeats fixed values, stopping when output reaches the start of the buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:fltintro:0:0218
name: read_bits_from_stream
description: Reads bits one at a time from a buffer of longwords, shifting each into a running value for as many iterations as the count in the input register, and carries the last bit state from one iteration to the next.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:fltintro:0:026C
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains a trap instruction followed by bad instruction data, so it is not executable code. It is reached only through a pc-relative address.

description: Contains a trap instruction followed by bad instruction data, so it is not executable code. It is reached only through a pc-relative address.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:c/Stack:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in the base block into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It then calls the code address held in a second register and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:0:0000
name: initialize_task_and_run
description: Clears a flag, queries a task structure through a library table, and when a field of it is zero calls two library routines and stores the second result as the flag. It then calls a routine and, if the flag is set, calls two more library routines before returning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:0:006E
name: run_main_timing_loop
description: Initializes several globals, then runs an endless frame loop. Each pass advances a 32-bit counter and reads an input code; when the code is one of five digit values or the counter passes a limit, it waits on a flag, resets state, and runs a second loop that updates counters and calls routines per step.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:13C9E
name: allocate_slot_from_table
description: Claims a free slot from a byte table: when the slot at the index in the input register is zero and a 16-bit counter is below 248, it stores the counter there, writes the index into a longword at that counter offset, advances the counter by four, and returns the counter. Otherwise it returns the slot's byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:13CB4
name: append_slot_entry_if_space
description: Stores a byte and a longword entry for the index in the input register at the current counter offset when the counter is below 248, then advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:13CC6
name: store_entry_and_advance_counter
description: Writes the low byte of its input into a byte table at the index in the data register, writes a longword into the structure at the input offset plus two, and advances the structure's 16-bit counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:13D18
name: partition_entries_by_extent
description: Clears a table of words, then, when the entry count is above a limit, copies and swaps the halves of each longword entry into a temporary buffer. It repeatedly partitions the entries in place along the component with the greatest extent and assigns each group a start index. The pseudo-code is truncated after the first part, so the tail is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:13F52
name: calculate_data_bounds
description: Scans a block of 16-bit words, splitting each into an 8-bit component and two 4-bit components. It tracks the minimum and maximum of each component and writes the three ranges and their total into a structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:18B5C
